changes: Verified shortlist retrieval for concepts and relationship contracts; protected relation meanings and separate senses.
Lossless prompt compression and keyed budgeted batches; valid siblings retained during bounded item repair.
Passage-wide gap planning and complete-answer checks against source and already accepted facts.
Atomic model caches and stage/item checkpoints; bounded Ollama retries and Windows atomic-replacement retries.
Qualified literal source/background review, bounded source coverage repair, conditional-premise guard, and background counterexample checks.
All arguments, modality and conditions preserved through graph publication and visible captions.
Evaluation uses precise quotation feedback, independently verified maximum one-to-one matching, and claim-specific context review.
Notebook is the single production implementation used by the CLI.

performance.interpretation: Cache-assisted full validation after iterative development, not fresh inference performance. Earlier costs are recorded separately.

resume_check.note: One fresh evaluation request was made; this is not a zero-inference resume. Inference checkpoints restored and the graph was identical.

evaluation.interpretation: A model-based reconstruction diagnostic, not an independently validated graph-accuracy percentage. The reviewer still rejects some reasonable paraphrases and the reconstructor can lose qualifiers.

manual_audit.method: Source edges compared with the supplied chapter; final source assertions verified unchanged from that audit. Background spot checks used primary references outside pipeline generation. No manually written facts or repairs were injected.
preserved_examples: Conditional training/test leakage consequence is qualified rather than asserting the hypothetical premise.
Tokenization and embedding action complements are retained.
Causal masking retains next-token conditions and training/generation scope.
Quantization stores parameters with fewer bits; aggressive reduction can degrade quality.
Dropout training versus ordinary inference is distinguished.
Retrieval does not itself change parameters; failure to find support does not prove a claim false.

background.assessment: Reasonable layered-network description of backpropagation and the chain rule.
Common noise-fitting description of overfitting; not an exhaustive characterization.
Neural retrieval encoder is a plausible implementation, but this architecture is not established by the source. Remains explicitly labelled background.

remaining_issues: Retrieval-precision definition, explicit dataset-separation requirement, and part of the conflicting-passages warning remain missing or incomplete.
Some source timing/scope and predicate wording remain ambiguous; the attention-weight predicate is stronger than the source wording about establishing truth.
Duplicate aliases and isolated extracted concepts remain, including an isolated null label.
Background reviews can overgeneralize or reject valid explanations. The neural-encoder implementation is an assumption, not a source fact.
Automatic reconstruction/evaluation is still fallible; do not use model agreement or the aggregate score as proof of accuracy.
Unresolved extraction/review history remains explicit, so the run reports completed_with_issues.

original_failure.finding: The saved run ended in an Ollama HTTP 500 CUDA error after extensive repeated registry searches. This does not establish the cause of the PC crash.

later_recovery.finding: Windows denied an atomic artifact replacement. Added bounded retries and resumed using saved cache; tests verify old artifacts remain intact on exhaustion.
